items.title: 12.4 Sources of oxides of nitrogen (nitrogen ke oxides kahan se aate hain) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.4 heading, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOₓ (NO aur NO₂) ke sources (zaraye) do bari qismon mein hain: natural (qudrati) sources (12.4.1) aur human (anthropogenic, man-made) sources (12.4.2).

blocks.prompt: Petrol engine mein nitrogen oxides kyun bante hain jab ke petrol mein nitrogen nahi hoti?
blocks.explanation: Engine jo hawa andar kheenchta hai us ka taqreeban chaar-panchwan hissa N₂ hai. Jalne ke zyada temperature par is N₂ ka kuch hissa oxygen se react karta hai: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO; phir NO hawa mein oxidise ho kar NO₂ ban jati hai.

items: NOₓ ke sources: natural aur human (anthropogenic).
